name: suenolytics-pwa
description: PWA responsive para seguimiento del sueno del bebe sobre Cloudflare Pages Functions y D1.

scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name suenolytics-pwa
scripts.check: npx wrangler pages functions build functions --project-directory . --outdir build/functions
scripts.syntax: node --check public/app.js && node --check functions/_shared/sleep-core.js && node --check functions/api/profile.js && node --check functions/api/status.js && node --check functions/api/action.js && node --check functions/app.webmanifest.js
